title: Sum of Array
statement: Return the sum of all values in nums. Implement Solution::arraySum; the hidden driver handles input and output.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n space-separated integers.
referenceSolution: class Solution { public: long long arraySum(vector<int>& nums) { return accumulate(nums.begin(), nums.end(), 0LL); } };

title: Largest Element
statement: Return the largest value in the non-empty array nums. Implement Solution::largestElement.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n space-separated integers.
referenceSolution: class Solution { public: int largestElement(vector<int>& nums) { return *max_element(nums.begin(), nums.end()); } };

title: First Occurrence
statement: Given a sorted array nums and target, return the first zero-based index of target, or -1 if absent. Use O(log n) time. Implement Solution::firstOccurrence.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n space-separated integers. Third line: target.
referenceSolution: class Solution { public: int firstOccurrence(vector<int>& nums, int target) { auto it = lower_bound(nums.begin(), nums.end(), target); return it != nums.end() && *it == target ? int(it - nums.begin()) : -1; } };
